question: What approaches the supreme self-luminous-natured at the end of that touch?
premises: At the end of that touch, awareness occurs.
That awareness is formed as pure consciousness-space.
Established in that awareness, one approaches the supreme self-luminous-natured.
inference: The end of that touch yields pure-consciousness-space awareness, and established therein one approaches the supreme self-luminous reality.
uncertainties: The referent of "that touch" is not specified in this verse.
The subject of "established" is grammatically ambiguous.
The exact syntactic relation of "in which" is interpretive.
plain_english: But at the end of that touch, awareness, shaped as pure consciousness-space, in which one is established, approaches the supreme self-luminous.
